result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner remains overlaid on the already-rendered featured restaurant image in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, covering the middle of the dish photo even though the image and all text below it (name, rating, delivery time, cuisine) are fully rendered.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image has finished loading so the featured photo displays unobstructed.
